title: RustDesk Client for Windows reg_recovery Missing Authorization Local Privilege Escalation… (CVE-2026-131827)
description: A local privilege escalation vulnerability exists in RustDesk Client for Windows due to missing authorization checks in the main IPC endpoint of the RustDesk service. An attacker with the ability to execute low-privileged code can exploit this flaw to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level and execute arbitrary code. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-131827 and has a high severity rating.
